name: ZTOE address audit

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.11"

      - name: Install deps
        run: pip install "pymongo>=4" "python-telegram-bot>=21"

      - name: Audit addresses to log channel
        env:
          MONGO_URI: ${{ secrets.MONGO_URI }}
          MONGO_DB: ${{ secrets.MONGO_DB }}
          ZTOE_BOT_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.ZTOE_BOT_TOKEN }}
          TELEGRAM_LOG_CHANNEL_ID: ${{ secrets.TELEGRAM_LOG_CHANNEL_ID }}
          TELEGRAM_LOG_THREAD_ID: "153"
        run: python ztoe_address_audit.py
